learning_outcomes.text: Understands the operation of digital circuits in measuring instruments.
Understands methods of programming digital processing of measurement data and measurement control.
Is able to independently design a simple digital measuring instrument.
Is able to present the results of their work.

syllabus_topics: Basic functional blocks implemented in TTL and CMOS technology.
Methods and languages for designing digital structures.
Techniques for using digital hardware and microcontrollers for real-time operation.
Structure of a digital measuring instrument.
Basic algorithms for processing measurement signals.
Digital measurements of power and RMS values.
Implementation of FFT and digital filters.

The subject includes a project on a topic selected from one lecture issue. The content and scope of the project expand the knowledge conveyed during lectures. An important element of the project is to stimulate creativity in solutions and enable further work, e.g., in a diploma thesis.
assessment_rules: Lectures are assessed based on involvement in teamwork, test results, and presentation. Project classes are assessed based on the engineering project, test results, and presentation. The method of verification of learning outcomes involves completing the classes.
bibliography: Majewski W.: Układy logiczne, WNT, Warszawa, 2003.
